## The empty-rule stub: a zero-width match is not expressible bare —
## the compiler says so — but a CAPTURED empty literal is the marker:
## `"" as name` parses nothing and binds the empty string. That is the
## prototyping stub: a rule that compiles, matches, and awaits a body.
grammar EmptyStub version "1.0.0" {
  ws = %x20
  pq = *ws
  stub = "" as marker
  top = pq stub pq

  entry main: top

  test {
    accept ""
    accept "   "
  }
}
